title: sdk-bizplan-persistence
description: persistBizplanPlan(handoff) writes .ok/plans/pln-<id>.json with PRD cross-ref (read from ok prd list); spawnExecutorTask(plan) writes .ok/tasks/tsk-<id>.json (status claimed, links planId).
evidence: e70e47ee11de5f25acf7a4a7a4d8d8843b662925: fix(sdk,commands): make okDir optional in persistBizplanPlan / spawnExecutorTask; rewrite bizplan command files as thin pointers
acceptance: persistBizplanPlan atomically writes .ok/plans/pln-<id>.json with PRD cross-ref
spawnExecutorTask writes .ok/tasks/tsk-<id>.json with status=claimed and links.planId
okDir is optional (defaults to project root .ok/)
